name: build2026fall
description: Root scripts: `npm run dev` starts every part of the app; `npm test` and `npm run lint` check both sides.

scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: uv run --directory backend ruff check && uv run --directory backend ruff format --check
scripts.lint:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
